description: Defines the DnsQuery class for constructing, parsing, and managing DNS query messages, including related enums, constructors, and methods.

classes.name: DnsQuery
classes.description: Represents a DNS query message, providing methods for construction, parsing, cloning, and access to query fields.

methods.name: DnsQuery
methods.description: Constructor that creates a DNS query from parameters including name, type, optional rdata, and padding strategy.

methods.name: DnsQuery
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a DNS query from a raw buffer.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses the stored raw packet to populate the DNS query fields.

methods.name: CloneWithNewId
methods.description: Creates a copy of the DNS query with a new ID.

methods.name: qname
methods.description: Returns the query name as a byte span.

methods.name: question
methods.description: Returns the question section as a string piece.

methods.name: question_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the question section.

methods.name: io_buffer
methods.description: Returns the IOBuffer used for writing the query.

methods.name: set_flags
methods.description: Sets flags for the DNS query.
